content:
The labeled function is

\[
f(x)=\ln(x).
\]

The graph of \(g\) has the same vertical asymptote \(x=0\) and the same shape, but it is shifted upward. Since \(f(1)=0\) while \(g(1)=4\), the vertical shift is \(4\) units.

Therefore,

\[
\boxed{g(x)=\ln(x)+4}
\]
